# Included GptLean sources

`lean/` is independent of the sibling `gpt_lean/` project. The local `GptLean/` directory contains exactly the 679 upstream modules in the transitive import closure of `PfHk.lean`, totalling 6,084,249 source bytes. Their contents and module names are unchanged. Selection is by module, so imported modules retain all their declarations. The local `GptLean.lean` aggregate imports this subset only.

Lean and mathlib remain ordinary external dependencies. Their versions are pinned in `lean-toolchain`, `lakefile.toml` and `lake-manifest.json`. No path dependency points to the old project. Install the dependencies with `lake exe cache get`, then run `./verify.sh` to compile both the PfHk and vendored GptLean sources and audit their full dependency closure. `lake build` is also configured for the `PfHk` and `Audit` entrypoints. Neither command needs the paper file.

`GptLean_provenance.json` lists the selected upstream files and their SHA-256 hashes. `GptLean_ASSUMPTIONS.md` is an unchanged archival copy of the upstream assumptions record. It describes more of the original project than this subset and retains links to files that are not included here. The current project's assumptions and endpoints are described in the parent README. No upstream project license file was present. Original source contents and notices are preserved.

`GptLean_source_snapshot.json` and `GptLean_lake-manifest.json` preserve the historical verification evidence and dependency pins used before vendoring. `migrate_snapshot.py` checks these archives, the previous PfHk snapshot and the copied source/artifact hashes. It writes `migration_snapshot.json` for explicit historical artifact reuse. This migration runs no Lean compiler and makes no claim of a fresh source rebuild. It deliberately excludes the PfHk aggregate so the subsequent verifier recompiles that entrypoint and its generated axiom audit.

The migration contains 679 GptLean source/artifact pairs and 386 individual PfHk module pairs. Of the GptLean pairs, 296 have direct successful source-check records and 383 have matching dependency fingerprints in successful checks. The subsequent verifier audits every declaration in all 1,066 imported modules. Any changed vendored source invalidates reuse for every dependent local module.

Compiled artifacts and installed mathlib packages live under the ignored `.lake/` directory. The source distribution does not need those existing artifacts because `./verify.sh` can rebuild all local sources after the pinned mathlib cache is installed. Hash-based reuse requires the matching artifacts as well as the snapshot.

The completed relocation check is recorded in [standalone_verification.json](standalone_verification.json). The temporary project had no sibling GptLean project or paper file. Both the generated and public audits passed for 27,438 declarations in 1,066 modules, with only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound` allowed. The GptLean subset aggregate also compiled, and eight Python regression checks passed. The record identifies the reused artifacts, freshly compiled entrypoints, verification scripts and log hashes.

That relocation record predates the exceptional-set extension. Its scope snapshot and log are preserved in [pre_exceptional_snapshot.json](../verification_history/pre_exceptional_snapshot.json) and [pre_exceptional_verification.log](../verification_history/pre_exceptional_verification.log). The parent README and current scope snapshot report the expanded project. The required GptLean subset is unchanged.
